verdict.rationale: Braintrust has some built-in recurring automation. Patterns runs Loop over the trace backlog on a schedule, online scoring and Topics run continuously on incoming traces, and evals can run on every pull request through external CI/CD. However, nothing in the evidence shows users can define their own scheduled jobs or workflows, such as cron-style recurring evals. Missing for 10: general user-defined job scheduling, configurable schedules or intervals for evals and workflows, documentation on managing scheduled runs, independent corroboration.
